blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Maple Ridge is a single city on the north bank of the Fraser River, bounded west by Pitt Meadows and east by Mission, with Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) and Dewdney Trunk Road as its two east–west house corridors.

The City's own neighbourhood list names Albion/Kanaka, Port Hammond, Port Haney, Ruskin, Silver Valley, Thornhill, Town Centre, Webster's Corners, Whonnock and Yennadon — board sub-area names such as West Central and Cottonwood do not appear on that City list.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Detached houses in Maple Ridge sit mainly in the RS (Single Detached Residential) zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019; the RS-1 schedule sets a minimum lot area of 668.0 m², minimum width 18.0 m, minimum depth 27.0 m and maximum lot coverage of 40%.
Rural house lots use larger RS-2 and RS-3 minimums and farm lots use A-1 (2.0 ha), A-2 (4.0 ha) and A-3 (8.0 ha) minimums in the same bylaw schedule.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: City-wide, one secondary suite per lot is permitted, inside the single detached building, at no more than 40% of the building's total gross floor area, and not in the Floodplain Area; a building permit is required.

Eligible single-detached and duplex lots can now have up to three, four, or six units of small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) — secondary suites, detached garden suites or coach houses, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes — if zoning, bylaw and building code rules are met.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Maple Ridge households arrange their own garbage disposal; the City does not provide curbside recycling, which Recycle BC provides at no cost to residents, and the Maple Ridge Recycling Depot at 10092 236th Street is run by Ridge Meadows Recycling Society.

Garbage carts may go out no earlier than 5:00 a.m. and must be removed by 7:00 p.m. on collection day under the City's bear-aware guidance, because garbage and compost draw bears into Maple Ridge neighbourhoods.
Ridge Meadows Hospital at 11666 Laity Street is the Fraser Health community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: development and new projects

items.t: City-level: updates to the Official Community Plan and the Town Centre, Hammond and Silver Valley area plans were adopted November 25, 2025, and the Albion Area Plan update was adopted in October 2025, to meet the Province's December 31, 2025 housing-legislation deadline.

City-level: on October 17, 2026 voters did not approve borrowing for the three Recreation Ready projects — Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre, Hammond Multi-Use Community Park and Albion Twin-Rink Arena Expansion — so those projects cannot proceed under that funding plan.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The City's 2026 tax-rate summary lists the Class 1 Residential general municipal rate at 2.86430 per $1,000 of assessed value, within a total Class 1 mill rate of 4.53578 per $1,000 including other taxing authorities.

The 2026 summary lists the flat-rate water charge at $859.25, or $191.65 per parcel where that basis applies, and flat-rate customers are billed water and sewer on the tax notice while metered customers are billed quarterly.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: getting around

items.t: TransLink's Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line is planned at 22 kilometres with 13 stations, running via 200 Street, the Golden Ears Bridge and Lougheed Highway, connecting to Haney Place, Ridge Meadows Hospital and the future Surrey Langley SkyTrain at Willowbrook.
On May 12, 2026 Council endorsed TransLink's 30% concept design for that BRT line, with five Maple Ridge stations: Lougheed Highway at 203, 207, Laity and 216 Streets, plus the Haney Place terminus.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: The first check for any Maple Ridge lot is the new Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026, approved July 28, 2026, which designates floodplain areas in its Schedule A and sets flood construction levels and setbacks for the Fraser River, the Alouette River system, steep creeks and groundwater flooding.
8121-2026, and no building or fill may go inside a Floodplain Setback.

Properties in the City's Wildfire Development Permit Area need a development permit for development, subdivision or building permits, and a single detached home may instead need a restrictive covenant covering building design and landscaping.

Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status is per parcel; on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission frame is one principal residence plus at most one additional smaller residence, with size limits that depend on parcel size.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Maple Ridge

Under the Golden Ears, Maple Ridge is a Fraser River city with ten distinct pockets from Albion to Whonnock between the mountains and the river. It works well for commuters on the Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk corridors, and for West Coast Express riders out of Port Haney and Maple Meadows.
Maple Ridge houses: what sold, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

478 houses sold in Maple Ridge with a median price of $1,174,950 (the middle half sold between $1,000,000 and $1,350,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $447 per square foot, a median year built of 1993 and a median lot of 6,372 square feet.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 388 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 59 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 15%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Maple Ridge?

faq.a: The October report gave $1,152,500 for houses in Maple Ridge, against $1,131,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.
faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Maple Ridge?

faq.a: The October report showed 33 days on market for houses in Maple Ridge and a sale-to-list price ratio of 96%, against 29 days the month before.
faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Maple Ridge?
What did houses in Maple Ridge sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Maple Ridge recorded 478 house sales at a median of $1,174,950.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Maple Ridge sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 478 houses that sold in Maple Ridge went for between $1,000,000 and $1,350,000, around a median of $1,174,950.

faq.q: Do houses in Maple Ridge sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 478 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.2% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The median year built was 1993 for the 478 houses sold in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Maple Ridge usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Maple Ridge had 4 bedrooms, from the 478 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge communities sold the most houses?
faq.a: By number sold: East Central (79), Albion (78), Southwest Maple Ridge (70), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
